release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.4.9 Table Customization, Single-Side Tendon ID & Chair Table Separation:
• Table Export Customizer: Toggle buttons beneath each column allow custom column visibility; unselected columns are hidden from display and excluded from Excel & CSV exports.
• Single-Side Tendon ID Block Placement: ID blocks appear on exactly one side (Left for horizontal/Latitude cables, Above for vertical/Longitude cables), at live or dead end, oriented along tendon inclination.
• 3-Strand vs 5-Strand Dead-End Chair Table Separation: Optional setting to separate dead-end chairs into distinct 3-strand and 5-strand summary tables across CAD drawings, Excel schedules, and the UI tables screen.
